overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines only differ in the declared type of data (Text vs Blob); this is one overload accepting either representation of the raw message, not two distinct call shapes.

params.name: data
params.description: Raw multipart/form-data HTTP message (a request or a response) to parse, as text or as a blob.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Parses a multipart/form-data HTTP message into a structured object, one property per part of the multipart data.
